conditions.condition_text: Draw a box using the high and low of the previous 4H candle, identifying the 25%, 50%, and 75% Fibonacci retracement levels.
The 4H candle box defines the premature zone for retracement.
Wait for price to manipulate and retrace into the premature zone (25% to 50% of the 4H box).
The 25-50% zone is the optimum area for a retracement before continuation.
Wait for a structural low/high to be broken and closed below/above, signaling a change of state.
A structural close confirms the intention of the move.
Enter on the new candle after price rebalances off a structural level (e.g., a breaker block or FVG).
Rebalancing off a structural level provides the final entry confirmation.
Price must break above the 4H candle high to establish a bullish bias.
Price must break below the 4H candle low to establish a bearish bias.
Price must retrace into the premature zone (25% to 50%) of the 4H box.
A structural low/high must be broken and closed to signal a change of state.
The 4H candle used to define the box must have a major body, not a skinny or indecisive wick.
The stop is placed below the most recent protective area, specifically a value gap.
The primary target is the opposite boundary of the 4H candle box.
The secondary target is the opposite boundary of the 4H candle box.
